下面脚本保存为语料库根目录 `build_catalog.py` 即可。它只读输入、只写六个输出文件，不做网络访问，不修改源文件。缺失全文 worker 证据卡、全文本地 PDF/TXT、被引用的 worker 报告 md 等会写入 `catalog-checks.json` 并以非零退出；但会先把能生成的目录写出来，避免“静默失败”。以下代码中所有统计数都运行时计算，不硬编码 59/60/13。 ```python #!/usr/bin/env python3 # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ build_catalog.py 离线目录生成器。只使用 Python 标准库。 用法： python3 build_catalog.py python3 build_catalog.py --root /path/to/corpus-root 默认 root 为 build_catalog.py 所在目录。 输出： catalog.json catalog.csv references.bib INDEX.md statistics.json catalog-checks.json 设计约束： - 不联网，不补 DOI，不猜 year/venue。 - 全文阅读状态统一为 fulltext_worker_reviewed；root 重点核查用 root_spotchecked 单独字段。 - 仅题录沿用输入 reading_status。 - 全文文件缺失、全文证据卡缺失、被引用本地链接缺失，均报告为 fatal，最终退出码非 0。 """ from __future__ import annotations import argparse import csv import hashlib import json import re import sys from collections import Counter from datetime import datetime, timezone from pathlib import Path TOPIC_ORDER = ["foundations", "gpu", "multigpu", "io", "accelerators", "lifecycle"] TOPIC_LABELS = { "foundations": "foundations（基础）", "gpu": "gpu", "multigpu": "multigpu", "io": "io", "accelerators": "accelerators", "lifecycle": "lifecycle", } DEFAULT_ACCESS_DATE = "2026-10-06" CSV_FIELDS = [ "work_id", "canonical_work_id", "version_id", "is_preferred", "title", "authors", "year", "venue", "topic", "relevance", "publication_status", "reading_status", "fulltext_available", "doi", "doi_valid", "source_url", "pdf", "text", "pdf_sha256", "text_sha256", "worker_report", "root_spotchecked", "metadata_note", "notes", "version_note", "metadata_source", ] DOI_PREFIX_RE = re.compile(r"^(?:https?://(?:dx\.)?doi\.org/|doi:\s*)", re.I) DOI_RE = re.compile(r"^10\.\d{4,9}/\S+$") BIB_ESCAPE_MAP = { "\\": r"\textbackslash{}", "&": r"\&", "%": r"\%", "_": r"\_", "#": r"\#", "$": r"\$", "{": r"\{", "}": r"\}", "~": r"\textasciitilde{}", "^": r"\textasciicircum{}", } def add_issue(issues, level, code, message, ident=None): issues.append({ "level": level, "code": code, "message": message, "id": ident, }) def is_missing(v): return v is None or v == "" or v == [] def norm_empty(v): return None if is_missing(v) else v def derive_access_date(root: Path) -> str: m = re.search(r"(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})$", root.name) if m: return f"{m.group(1)}-{m.group(2)}-{m.group(3)}" return DEFAULT_ACCESS_DATE def load_json_file(path: Path, issues, default, required=False): if not path.is_file(): if required: add_issue(issues, "fatal", "missing_required_file", f"缺少必需文件：{path}", None) return default try: with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f) except Exception as e: add_issue(issues, "fatal", "json_load_error", f"读取 JSON 失败：{path}: {e}", None) return default def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with path.open("rb") as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b""): h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest() def clean_doi(doi): if is_missing(doi): return None, False, None raw = str(doi).strip() cleaned = DOI_PREFIX_RE.sub("", raw).strip() valid = bool(DOI_RE.match(cleaned)) return cleaned, valid, raw def missing_metadata_fields(obj): missing = [] for field in ("year", "venue", "doi", "authors"): if is_missing(obj.get(field)): missing.append(field) return missing def anchor(prefix, ident): safe = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", "-", str(ident)).strip("-") if not safe: safe = "item" return f"{prefix}-{safe}" def md_cell(s): if s is None: return "null" return str(s).replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ").strip() def md_link(path, text): if not path: return "" return f"[{text}]({path})" def bib_escape(s): if s is None: return "" return "".join(BIB_ESCAPE_MAP.get(ch, ch) for ch in str(s)) def bib_key(s): key = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9:_-]+", "-", str(s)).strip("-") return key or "ref" def pick_meta(card, override, field, default=None): if field in override: return override.get(field) if card is not None and field in card: return card.get(field) return default def pick_rec_override(rec, override, field, default=None): if field in override: return override.get(field) return rec.get(field, default) def build_work(canonical, versions, is_family): for i, v in enumerate(versions): v["canonical_work_id"] = canonical v["is_preferred"] = (i == 0) pref = versions[0] def first_val(field, default=None): for v in versions: val = v.get(field) if not is_missing(val): return val return default title = first_val("title", canonical) authors = first_val("authors", []) if not isinstance(authors, list): authors = [] year = first_val("year") venue = first_val("venue") doi = first_val("doi") doi_valid = False if doi: _, doi_valid, _ = clean_doi(doi) publication_status = first_val("publication_status", "uncertain") relevance = first_val("relevance", "uncertain") topic = pref.get("topic") or first_val("topic", "other") topics = sorted({v.get("topic") for v in versions if not is_missing(v.get("topic"))}) fulltext_available = any(v.get("fulltext_available") for v in versions) reading_status = "fulltext_worker_reviewed" if fulltext_available else first_val("reading_status", "metadata_only") root_spotchecked = any(v.get("root_spotchecked") for v in versions) source_url = first_val("source_url") metadata_source = first_val("metadata_source") metadata_notes = [v.get("metadata_note") for v in versions if not is_missing(v.get("metadata_note"))] notes = [v.get("notes") for v in versions if not is_missing(v.get("notes"))] version_notes = [v.get("version_note") for v in versions if not is_missing(v.get("version_note"))] work = { "id": canonical, "canonical_work_id": canonical, "title": title, "authors": authors, "year": year, "venue": venue, "doi": doi, "doi_valid": doi_valid, "publication_status": publication_status, "relevance": relevance, "topic": topic, "topics": topics, "fulltext_available": fulltext_available, "reading_status": reading_status, "root_spotchecked": root_spotchecked, "source_url": source_url, "metadata_source": metadata_source, "metadata_notes": metadata_notes, "notes": notes, "version_notes": version_notes, "version_count": len(versions), "preferred_version_id": pref["id"], "versions": versions, "is_work_family": is_family, "version_comparison_note": "同一工作的多个版本各自独立保存与审读；未做逐字比对。", "unknown_fields": [], } work["unknown_fields"] = missing_metadata_fields(work) return work def write_json(path: Path, obj): with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(obj, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) f.write("\n") def write_csv(path: Path, rows): with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f: writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=CSV_FIELDS) writer.writeheader() for row in rows: writer.writerow({k: row.get(k, "") for k in CSV_FIELDS}) def write_bib(path: Path, works, access_date): entries = [] seen = {} for w in works: key_base = bib_key(w["id"]) n = seen.get(key_base, 0) + 1 seen[key_base] = n key = key_base if n == 1 else f"{key_base}-{n}" fields = [] if w.get("authors"): fields.append(f" author = {{{bib_escape(' and '.join(w['authors']))}}}") if w.get("title"): fields.append(f" title = {{{{{bib_escape(w['title'])}}}}}") if w.get("year") is not None: fields.append(f" year = {{{w['year']}}}") if w.get("venue"): fields.append(f" howpublished = {{{bib_escape(w['venue'])}}}") if w.get("doi"): fields.append(f" doi = {{{w['doi']}}}") if w.get("source_url"): fields.append(f" url = {{{w['source_url']}}}") note_parts = [] status = w.get("publication_status") or "uncertain" if status == "accepted_upcoming": note_parts.append("待开会（accepted_upcoming），不得视为已正式出版") elif status == "preprint": note_parts.append("预印本（preprint），不得视为已正式出版") elif status == "published": note_parts.append("出版状态：published") elif status == "uncertain": note_parts.append("出版状态未定（uncertain）") else: note_parts.append(f"出版状态：{status}") if w.get("version_count", 1) > 1: note_parts.append(f"包含 {w['version_count']} 个版本；首选版本 {w.get('preferred_version_id')}；未做逐字比对") if w.get("reading_status"): note_parts.append(f"阅读状态：{w['reading_status']}") note_parts.append(f"访问日期：{access_date}") fields.append(f" note = {{{bib_escape('；'.join(note_parts))}}}") entries.append("@misc{" + key + ",\n" + ",\n".join(fields) + "\n}") path.write_text("\n\n".join(entries) + "\n", encoding="utf-8") def work_pdf_cell(work): pref = work["versions"][0] if pref.get("fulltext_available") and pref.get("pdf"): return md_link(pref["pdf"], "PDF") if pref.get("source_url"): return md_link(pref["source_url"], "来源") return "—" def work_evidence_cell(work): pref = work["versions"][0] if pref.get("fulltext_available"): if pref.get("worker_report"): return md_link(pref["worker_report"], "证据卡") return "证据卡缺失" return f"题录深度：{md_cell(pref.get('reading_status'))}" def render_topic_section(lines, topic, topic_works): if not topic_works: return topic_works = sorted( topic_works, key=lambda w: ( w["year"] is None, w["year"] or 0, (w["title"] or "").lower(), w["id"], ), ) lines.append(f"\n## {TOPIC_LABELS.get(topic, topic)}\n") lines.append("| 年份 / 出版状态 | 题目 | PDF/来源 | 证据卡/深度 | 相关性 |") lines.append("|---|---|---|---|---|") for w in topic_works: work_anchor = anchor("work", w["id"]) year_status = f"{w['year'] if w['year'] is not None else 'null'} / {w['publication_status']}" title_cell = f'{md_cell(w["title"])}' if w["version_count"] > 1: title_cell += f"（{w['version_count']}版）" lines.append( "| " + " | ".join([ md_cell(year_status), title_cell, work_pdf_cell(w), work_evidence_cell(w), md_cell(w["relevance"]), ]) + " |" ) detail_works = [ w for w in topic_works if w["version_count"] > 1 or w["version_notes"] or w["metadata_notes"] or w["notes"] ] if not detail_works: return lines.append("\n### 版本与说明\n") for w in detail_works: summary = f'{md_cell(w["title"])}（{w["version_count"]} 个版本）' lines.append(f"
{summary}\n") for v in w["versions"]: v_anchor = anchor("version", v["id"]) pref_mark = "（首选）" if v["is_preferred"] else "" year_status = f"{v['year'] if v['year'] is not None else 'null'} / {v['publication_status']}" parts = [f'**{md_cell(v["id"])}**{pref_mark}：{md_cell(year_status)}'] if v.get("fulltext_available"): if v.get("pdf"): parts.append(f'PDF：{md_link(v["pdf"], v["pdf"])}') if v.get("worker_report"): parts.append(f'证据卡：{md_link(v["worker_report"], "worker报告")}') else: if v.get("source_url"): parts.append(f'来源：{md_link(v["source_url"], "题录")}') parts.append(f'深度：{md_cell(v.get("reading_status"))}') lines.append("- " + "；".join(parts)) for note in w["version_notes"] + w["metadata_notes"] + w["notes"]: lines.append(f"- 说明：{md_cell(note)}") if w["version_count"] > 1: lines.append("- 未对以上版本做逐字比对；版本差异以各自版本为准。") lines.append("\n
\n") def write_index(path: Path, works, stats, access_date): lines = [] lines.append("# 共享地址翻译文献目录\n") lines.append( f"截至 {access_date}，本目录包含 {stats['unique_work_count']} 项工作，" f"其中 {stats['fulltext_work_count']} 项有全文、{stats['fulltext_version_count']} 个全文版本，" f"另有 {stats['metadata_only_count']} 条仅题录。" ) lines.append( "全文阅读状态为 `fulltext_worker_reviewed`：证据来自模型阅读全文证据卡，" "并非复现实验；root 重点核查另见 `root_spotchecked` 字段。" ) lines.append( "未对同一工作的多个版本做逐字比对；版本差异以各自版本为准，" "不能据此声称逐字一致。" ) for topic in TOPIC_ORDER: render_topic_section(lines, topic, [w for w in works if w["topic"] == topic]) other_works = [w for w in works if w["topic"] not in TOPIC_ORDER] render_topic_section(lines, "other", other_works) lines.append("\n## 仍待核的 null 元数据\n") lines.append("以下字段在目录生成时仍为 null/未知；未根据文件名、hint 或联网补全。\n") null_work_items = [] for w in works: missing = set(w.get("unknown_fields", [])) for v in w["versions"]: missing.update(v.get("unknown_fields", [])) if missing: null_work_items.append((w, sorted(missing))) if not null_work_items: lines.append("- 无。\n") else: for w, missing in null_work_items: work_anchor = anchor("work", w["id"]) lines.append( f'- [{md_cell(w["title"])}](#{work_anchor})：' f'{", ".join(missing)} 为 null/未知' ) path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8") def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate offline catalog for shared translation literature.") parser.add_argument("--root", default=None, help="Corpus root. Defaults to the directory containing build_catalog.py.") args = parser.parse_args() root = Path(args.root).resolve() if args.root else Path(__file__).resolve().parent if not root.is_dir(): print(f"ERROR: root is not a directory: {root}", file=sys.stderr) return 2 access_date = derive_access_date(root) issues = [] # ------------------------------------------------------------------ # 1. catalog-seed.json # ------------------------------------------------------------------ seed_raw = load_json_file(root / "catalog-seed.json", issues, [], required=True) if not isinstance(seed_raw, list): add_issue(issues, "fatal", "invalid_catalog_seed", "catalog-seed.json 必须是 list", None) seed_raw = [] seed_by_id = {} for rec in seed_raw: if not isinstance(rec, dict): add_issue(issues, "warning", "invalid_seed_record", "catalog-seed.json 中存在非对象记录", None) continue rid = rec.get("id") if is_missing(rid): add_issue(issues, "warning", "seed_missing_id", "catalog-seed.json 记录缺少 id", None) continue rid = str(rid) if rid in seed_by_id: add_issue(issues, "warning", "duplicate_seed_id", f"catalog-seed.json 重复 id：{rid}", rid) seed_by_id[rid] = rec # ------------------------------------------------------------------ # 2. records/download-batch*.json # ------------------------------------------------------------------ download_files = sorted((root / "records").glob("download-batch*.json")) download_attempts = [] for f in download_files: data = load_json_file(f, issues, [], required=False) if not isinstance(data, list): add_issue(issues, "warning", "invalid_download_batch", f"{f} 不是 list", None) continue for idx, rec in enumerate(data): if not isinstance(rec, dict): continue rec = dict(rec) rec["_download_file"] = str(f.relative_to(root)) rec["_download_index"] = idx download_attempts.append(rec) success_by_id = {} download_missing_files = [] for rec in download_attempts: rid = rec.get("id") if is_missing(rid): continue rid = str(rid) if rec.get("status") != "downloaded_extracted": continue pdf = rec.get("pdf") text = rec.get("text") if is_missing(pdf) or is_missing(text): add_issue(issues, "warning", "download_success_missing_paths", f"{rid}: downloaded_extracted 但缺少 pdf/text 字段", rid) continue pdf_path = root / str(pdf) text_path = root / str(text) if not pdf_path.is_file() or not text_path.is_file(): download_missing_files.append({ "id": rid, "pdf": str(pdf), "text": str(text), "download_file": rec.get("_download_file"), }) continue # 后出现的成功记录覆盖先前的成功记录；失败尝试已在上面跳过。 success_by_id[rid] = rec for item in download_missing_files: add_issue( issues, "warning", "download_success_files_missing", f"{item['id']}: downloaded_extracted 但本地文件不存在（未纳入全文集）", item["id"], ) # ------------------------------------------------------------------ # 3. 合并全文集合：seed + 成功下载 # ------------------------------------------------------------------ fulltext_selected = {} for rid, rec in seed_by_id.items(): fulltext_selected[rid] = { "base": dict(rec), "seed_record": rec, "download_record": None, "source_kind": "catalog-seed", } for rid, rec in success_by_id.items(): if rid in fulltext_selected: base = dict(fulltext_selected[rid]["base"]) base.update(rec) fulltext_selected[rid] = { "base": base, "seed_record": fulltext_selected[rid]["seed_record"], "download_record": rec, "source_kind": "catalog-seed+download", } else: fulltext_selected[rid] = { "base": dict(rec), "seed_record": None, "download_record": rec, "source_kind": "download", } # ------------------------------------------------------------------ # 4. records/metadata-only.json # ------------------------------------------------------------------ metadata_only_raw = load_json_file(root / "records" / "metadata-only.json", issues, [], required=True) if not isinstance(metadata_only_raw, list): add_issue(issues, "fatal", "invalid_metadata_only", "records/metadata-only.json 必须是 list", None) metadata_only_raw = [] metadata_only_by_id = {} for rec in metadata_only_raw: if not isinstance(rec, dict): add_issue(issues, "warning", "invalid_metadata_only_record", "metadata-only.json 中存在非对象记录", None) continue rid = rec.get("id") if is_missing(rid): add_issue(issues, "warning", "metadata_only_missing_id", "metadata-only.json 记录缺少 id", None) continue rid = str(rid) if rid in metadata_only_by_id: add_issue(issues, "warning", "duplicate_metadata_only_id", f"metadata-only.json 重复 id：{rid}", rid) metadata_only_by_id[rid] = rec # ------------------------------------------------------------------ # 5. root-overrides.json / root-spotchecks.json / work-families.json # ------------------------------------------------------------------ root_overrides = load_json_file(root / "records" / "root-overrides.json", issues, {}, required=False) if not isinstance(root_overrides, dict): add_issue(issues, "fatal", "invalid_root_overrides", "records/root-overrides.json 必须是 dict", None) root_overrides = {} root_overrides = {str(k): v for k, v in root_overrides.items() if isinstance(v, dict)} spot_raw = load_json_file(root / "records" / "root-spotchecks.json", issues, [], required=False) root_spotchecks = set() if isinstance(spot_raw, dict): root_spotchecks.update(str(k) for k in spot_raw.keys()) elif isinstance(spot_raw, list): for item in spot_raw: if isinstance(item, str): root_spotchecks.add(item) elif isinstance(item, dict) and "id" in item: root_spotchecks.add(str(item["id"])) else: add_issue(issues, "warning", "invalid_root_spotchecks", "root-spotchecks.json 既不是 list 也不是 dict", None) work_families_raw = load_json_file(root / "records" / "work-families.json", issues, {}, required=False) if not isinstance(work_families_raw, dict): add_issue(issues, "fatal", "invalid_work_families", "records/work-families.json 必须是 dict", None) work_families_raw = {} work_families = {} for canonical, vlist in work_families_raw.items(): canonical = str(canonical) if not isinstance(vlist, list): add_issue(issues, "fatal", "invalid_work_family_versions", f"{canonical} 的版本列表不是 list", canonical) continue versions = [str(x) for x in vlist if isinstance(x, (str, int))] if len(versions) != len(vlist): add_issue(issues, "warning", "work_family_non_string_version", f"{canonical} 版本列表包含非字符串条目", canonical) if len(versions) != len(set(versions)): add_issue(issues, "fatal", "duplicate_version_in_work_family", f"{canonical} 版本列表有重复", canonical) work_families[canonical] = versions # ------------------------------------------------------------------ # 6. workers/G[1-8]_*-papers.json # ------------------------------------------------------------------ cards = {} card_reports = {} worker_files = sorted((root / "workers").glob("G[1-8]_*-papers.json")) if not worker_files: add_issue(issues, "warning", "no_worker_files", "未找到 workers/G[1-8]_*-papers.json", None) for wf in worker_files: stem = wf.name if stem.endswith("-papers.json"): stem = stem[:-len("-papers.json")] report_rel = f"workers/{stem}.md" data = load_json_file(wf, issues, {}, required=False) papers = data.get("papers", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else [] if not isinstance(papers, list): add_issue(issues, "warning", "invalid_worker_papers", f"{wf} 的 papers 不是 list", None) continue for paper in papers: if not isinstance(paper, dict): continue pid = paper.get("id") if is_missing(pid): add_issue(issues, "warning", "worker_card_missing_id", f"{wf} 中存在缺少 id 的证据卡", None) continue pid = str(pid) if pid in cards: add_issue(issues, "warning", "duplicate_worker_evidence_card", f"id {pid} 有重复 worker 证据卡", pid) cards[pid] = paper card_reports[pid] = report_rel if not (root / report_rel).is_file(): add_issue(issues, "fatal", "missing_worker_report_md", f"worker报告不存在：{report_rel}", pid) # ------------------------------------------------------------------ # 7. 构造全文版本 # ------------------------------------------------------------------ fulltext_versions = [] for rid in sorted(fulltext_selected.keys()): sel = fulltext_selected[rid] base = sel["base"] card = cards.get(rid) override = root_overrides.get(rid, {}) if card is None: add_issue(issues, "fatal", "missing_worker_evidence_card", f"全文版本缺少 worker 证据卡：{rid}", rid) title = pick_meta(card, override, "title") if is_missing(title): title = base.get("title_hint") or base.get("title") or rid authors = pick_meta(card, override, "authors", []) if not isinstance(authors, list): authors = [] if is_missing(authors) else [str(authors)] year = norm_empty(pick_meta(card, override, "year")) venue = norm_empty(pick_meta(card, override, "venue")) doi_raw = norm_empty(pick_meta(card, override, "doi")) doi, doi_valid, doi_original = clean_doi(doi_raw) publication_status = pick_meta(card, override, "publication_status") if is_missing(publication_status): publication_status = "uncertain" relevance = pick_meta(card, override, "relevance") if is_missing(relevance): relevance = "uncertain" topic = pick_meta(card, override, "topic") if is_missing(topic): topic = base.get("topic") or "other" reading_status = "fulltext_worker_reviewed" root_spotchecked = rid in root_spotchecks pdf = norm_empty(base.get("pdf") or (card.get("pdf") if card else None)) text = norm_empty(base.get("text") or (card.get("text") if card else None)) pdf_exists = bool(pdf and (root / str(pdf)).is_file()) text_exists = bool(text and (root / str(text)).is_file()) if not pdf_exists: add_issue(issues, "fatal", "missing_fulltext_pdf", f"全文PDF缺失：{rid} -> {pdf}", rid) if not text_exists: add_issue(issues, "fatal", "missing_fulltext_text", f"全文文本缺失：{rid} -> {text}", rid) pdf_sha = sha256_file(root / str(pdf)) if pdf_exists else None text_sha = sha256_file(root / str(text)) if text_exists else None pdf_sha_provided = base.get("pdf_sha256") if is_missing(pdf_sha_provided) and card: pdf_sha_provided = card.get("pdf_sha256") text_sha_provided = base.get("text_sha256") if is_missing(text_sha_provided) and card: text_sha_provided = card.get("text_sha256") if not is_missing(pdf_sha_provided) and pdf_sha and str(pdf_sha_provided) != pdf_sha: add_issue(issues, "warning", "pdf_sha256_mismatch", f"{rid}: pdf_sha256 与本地文件不一致", rid) if not is_missing(text_sha_provided) and text_sha and str(text_sha_provided) != text_sha: add_issue(issues, "warning",
